title: SWAC defensive line, 2026
scope: League games (both teams among the 18), garbage time excluded; SWAC defenses only.

definitions.dl: Players listed on that season's roster as defensive line (edge players listed as linebacker count as LB).
definitions.production: Sacks + run tackles for loss + forced fumbles + passes broken up. Shared sacks/TFL count half.
definitions.run_stop: A tackle on a run the offense did not succeed on (down-and-distance success).
definitions.rush_success: Share of runs that met the down-and-distance success line.
definitions.stuff: A run for zero or fewer yards.
definitions.short_yardage: 3rd or 4th down with 2 or fewer yards to go, run plays.
definitions.late_and_close: 4th quarter or overtime with the score within 8.
definitions.epa_taken: Expected points taken off the offense on the player's sacks, TFLs, forced fumbles and breakups.
definitions.no_snap_counts: We have production only -- no participation, snap counts or video. Rates are per team snap or per game.
